page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal note numbers (86, 87, 88, 89) in the right margin beside the paragraphs; a catchword-like mark at the foot centre. Running head at top.

main_text.p: & spoliatoribus ecclesiarum æditas, credo quòd intelligitur per has leges, quòd illi qui spoliant ecclesiam, quæ est homines inexcellentia status & virtutum per dotationes cæcas, instinctu d' abo‐li, extortas, sunt sacrilegi, & à triumph. ntecc‐clesia maledicti.

Deficit humana regula de eligendo prapositos, apostolo enim deficiente, reuelatione elegerunt Mathiam per sortem, sed factum eorum debet in isto, esse euidentius quam sequens dictu, uel factum Romani pontificis, quare adhuc debet Ecclesia intendere huic formæ.86

Implicans se electionibus secundum traditiones humanas, ubi posset secundu legem Dei procedere: peccat grauiter, et sic uidetur mihi quòd omnes adinuentiones hominũ præter fidem scripturæ, sunt secundum plus uel minus culpabiles.87

Quantum ad consecrationes locorũ, dicitur quod episcopi consecrantes, capiunt quinq; marcas, sed longè minus malum foret celebrare sub dio, quàm in loco taliter benedicto. Lepra enim spiritualis inficit parietes & loca d' stantia, cum Deus pro leuiori peccato subuerterit Sodomam & Gomorram.88
Talis consecratio nõ est uera consecratio, sed execratio & maledicta, retardans fideles à mi‐89

page.notes: Marginal numbers 86–89 are side note references. Catchword/signature at foot is a mark ("ßß") rather than a clear word; left as the unclear mark. Several words in the text are blurred (e.g. "execratio", "retardans fideles" and "d' stantia") and may be misread. Right side of page shows show-through from the other side and is omitted.
